newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Budapest bourse says suspends Hungagent.
newsitem.headline: Budapest bourse says suspends Hungagent.

text.p: The Budapest Stock Exchange suspended trading in shares of trading company Hungagent Rt for the rest of the day after an excessive rally, a bourse official told Reuters.
"We suspended Hungagent for the day because it rose more than 20 percent," she said.
The suspension on Thursday came at 1002 GMT when Hungagent traded at 1,275 forints, 30 percent above its opening price of 975 forints.
The bourse suspends trading in any share if it moves more than 20 percent in either direction compared to the previous closing price.

In Hungagent's case, however, the bourse compared the rise to the opening price of 975 forints instead of the closing price of 900 forints reached on June 24, because more than five trading days had passed since the last trading day.
